question.text: An AIF scheme must not have more than how many investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that no scheme of the AIF shall have more than 1,000 investors. The limit applies at the scheme level, and the workbook ties AIF corpus raising to private placement. The Trap: The cap is per scheme, not per fund. An AIF with multiple schemes will be subject to the 1,000-investor cap separately on each scheme. Note: The investor cap supports the privately pooled / private placement character of AIFs.
